segments.text: Connect the wire feeder.
The wire feeder is used to feed wire in laser welding, and it is not needed in metal cleaning or cutting.
Place the wire feeder on the left side of the main unit. Lock the four caster wheels.
Connect to the main unit. Use the wire feeder cable to connect them.
The small protrusion on the inner wall faces upwards.
Insert the connector.
Screw the metal part.
Install the drive rolls. This video exemplifies installing one millimeter welding wire on the one millimeter guiding rail.
Open the wire feeder.
Open the wire feeding driver.
Remove the screws.
Install the drive rolls.
Install the screws back. Store the other pair of drive rolls above the wire feeding driver.
Install the wire feeding tube.
Close the right tensioner.
Loosen the screw on the right side of the wire feeding driver.
Insert the end of the wire feeding tube without a fastener to the wire feeder.
Lead the nozzle in until its stem presses against the right panel of the wire feeding driver.
Tighten the screw to fix the nozzle.
Open the right tensioner.
Load the welding wire.
Unscrew the cap and remove the sleeve.
Align the hole with the pin.
Ensure that the wire spool is installed in the correct direction.
After released, the wire comes out from the bottom of the wire spool to enter the wire feeding driver.
Install the sleeve and the cap back.
Take out the wire end. Do not release the wire or it will unravel.
Cut off the bent end of the wire.
Thread the wire into the wire feeding driver.
Press the wire slightly to make it pass through.
Ensure that the wire passes through the drive rolls into the wire feeding tube.
Close the tensioners.
Rotate the tensioner's knobs to adjust the wire feed tension.
Feed the welding wire.
When delivered, the wire feeding tube is installed with a 0.8 slash 1.0 nozzle at the end with a fastener.
Press and hold the feed button on the wire feeder.
The wire spool rotates counterclockwise at a constant speed.
When the wire extends from the nozzle, stop wire feeding.
If the wire extends too far, press the retract button to return the wire.
Close the door of the wire feeder.
Install the wire feeding tube on the welding head.
Open the fastener.
Slide it onto the welding head tip.
Ensure that the wire comes out from the groove of the welding nozzle.
Close the fastener.
Fine-tune the wire.
Secure the wire feeding tube.
Place back on the welding head cradle.
